stories.title: Motorcyclist dies after crash in Terrebonne Parish, state police say
stories.summary: A 27-year-old Thibodaux motorcyclist died after a driver failed to yield at a stop sign on Thanksgiving Day, troopers said.

stories.title: Missing New York tourist no longer in New Orleans, NOPD says
stories.summary: Police say 29-year-old Daniel Minnock's whereabouts are unknown since he departed New Orleans via passenger transport instead of his scheduled flight.

stories.title: Texas truck driver faces felonies after three-car crash kills Slidell man
stories.summary: Investigators say the driver in question did not stop when traffic was stalled on Interstate 10 in West Baton Rouge Parish.

stories.title: New report finds some AI toys are able to tell kids dangerous and inappropriate information
stories.summary: All three toys tested in the study shared where to find matches and knives in a home, and one toy talked about a range of sexually explicit topics.

stories.title: 'It just spread': 11 displaced, firefighter hospitalized after overnight fire in Mariner's Cove
stories.summary: Strong winds helped spread the fire on Spinnaker Lane near West End, leaving six homes with moderate to severe damage.

stories.title: Links on 4: News Links
stories.summary: Watch the WWL Louisiana News team every day on WWL-TV and WUPL.

stories.title: 'A good time': Black Friday shoppers flood Lakeside Shopping Center for deals, holiday traditions
stories.summary: From a nearly 20-year shopping tradition to a mission for the perfect pair of Jordans, shoppers flocked to the Metairie mall to kick off the holiday shopping season.

stories.title: Looming federal THC drink ban could end production for local brands
stories.summary: A new bipartisan Senate bill could be a lifeline, but time is running out for the THC drink industry.

stories.title: Gov. Landry announces $35 million plan to cover Belle Chasse Bridge tolls for 5 years
stories.summary: Gov. Jeff Landry announced a $35 million deal that could cover Belle Chasse Bridge tolls for eligible drivers for five years, though no start date is set.

stories.title: LSU New Orleans names first chancellor since rejoining LSU system
stories.summary: LSU New Orleans rejoined the LSU system on July 1.

stories.title: Six family members identified after deadly plane crash off Mississippi coast
stories.summary: The family was reportedly returning from a fishing trip when the plane went down two miles northeast of Horn Island.

stories.title: Freeze Watch for parts of Northshore, south Mississippi late Thursday into Friday
stories.summary: Forecasters warn that freezing morning temperatures could kill crops and damage outdoor plants.
